chapters.name: The Morning Pages
chapters.intro: Gaspard believed mornings should begin gently — with warmth, aroma, and conversation.

items.name: Carmella's Breakfast
items.story: Named for the house — generous, unhurried, complete.
items.desc: Two eggs, streaky bacon, pork sausages, oven-roasted tomato, mushrooms. Served with ciabatta.

items.name: Mini Carmella Breakfast
items.story: The same morning, in miniature.
items.desc: One egg, choice of streaky bacon, pork or beef sausage, or mushrooms. With a slice of bread.

items.name: Amy's Choice
items.story: Amy never could decide — so she chose them all.
items.desc: Traditional omelette or scrambled eggs.

variants.name: Smoked salmon, spinach and goat cheese

items.name: Mademoiselle Benedict
items.story: Poached properly, sauced without apology.
items.desc: On an English muffin with hollandaise sauce.

items.name: Diane's French Toast
items.story: Diane soaked brioche in cream and never looked back.
items.desc: Pan-fried brioche or vanilla cake soaked in egg and cream.

items.name: Sunday Memory
items.story: Every Sunday, the same table, the same joy.
items.desc: Egg-dipped ciabatta filled with bacon, feta and avocado.

items.name: Nicole in Thessaloniki
items.story: Fruit and yoghurt, the way Nicole ate it by the Aegean.
items.desc: Seasonal fruit bowl, Greek yoghurt, and flaked almonds or nuts.

items.name: Monique at Home
items.story: Monique's kitchen, folded into an omelette.
items.desc: Italian omelette, crustless quiche. Bacon and mushroom, or spinach and feta.

items.name: A Day in Paris
items.story: Butter, jam, and nowhere to be.
items.desc: Fresh croissant served with butter and jam.

items.name: Nama in London
items.story: Two scones, tea optional, manners mandatory.
items.desc: Two scones served with butter and jam.

items.name: Whole Oats
items.story: Slow oats for slow mornings.
items.desc: Oat porridge, seeds and nuts mix.

items.name: Morning in Jozi
items.story: Home, wrapped and ready for the city.
items.desc: Breakfast wrap: scrambled eggs, streaky bacon, tomato, onions and cheese mix.

chapters.name: The Global Table
chapters.intro: Every meal is an invitation to travel — the shores of the Mediterranean, the cafés of Paris, the tavernas of Greece.

items.name: Soup of the Day
items.story: Whatever the season whispered to the kitchen.
items.desc: A daily chef's creation inspired by the season.

items.name: Burrata in Venice
items.story: Gaspard first tasted this beside a canal, and never quite recovered.
items.desc: Creamy burrata, sweet cherry tomatoes, pine nuts and basil.

items.name: Ceviche in Lima
items.story: Bright lime, cool coconut — Lima at noon.
items.desc: Fresh catch of the day marinated in lime, coconut milk, chili and coriander.

items.name: Calamari in Nice
items.story: Sun-kissed, lemon-laced, unmistakably Riviera.
items.desc: Tender calamari sautéed in a sun-kissed medley of lemon, parsley, chili and tomato.

items.name: Prawns in Maputo
items.story: Garlic butter and chili, the Maputo way.
items.desc: Pan-seared prawns finished in garlic butter, chili and parsley.

items.name: Naples Aubergine
items.story: Layered like the old city itself.
items.desc: Slow-roasted aubergine layered with spicy minced beef, melted cheese and toasted pine nuts.

items.name: Monaco
items.story: Puff pastry with a yacht-club attitude.
items.desc: Puff pastry pizza topped with spicy trout or tuna, sesame seeds, sesame oil and cheese.

items.name: Brussels Mussel Pot
items.story: A pot of the North Sea, kept warm.
items.desc: Steamed mussels in a creamy garlic and herb cream sauce.

items.name: Calamari and Prawn Salad
items.story: The coast, arranged on greens.
items.desc: Roasted sweet potato, tender prawns and calamari served on a bed of greens.

items.name: Caesar in the City
items.story: The classic, dressed for town.
items.desc: Crisp romaine tossed in anchovy dressing, topped with aged parmesan and house-made croutons.

items.desc: Sweet potato, chicken, edamame beans, avocado salad and quinoa.

items.name: Sir Gaspard Salad
items.story: The house salad, knighted.
items.desc: Roasted cauliflower, mint, creamy goat cheese, avocado and caramelized walnuts, dressed with honey mustard vinaigrette.

items.name: Tomato Salad
items.story: Three ways of saying summer.
items.desc: Cherry tomatoes and basil served over a delicate tomato coulis.

items.name: Gaia's Tuna Carpaccio
items.story: Sliced thin, dressed in truffle, gone in minutes.

items.name: Mr. T Fish Papillote
items.story: Steam, parchment, and a little chorizo mischief.
items.desc: Delicately baked fish in parchment with herbs and spicy chorizo.

items.name: Athens
items.story: The Aegean, gathered into one bowl of orzo.
items.desc: Spicy tomato orzo pasta with assorted seafood: salmon, mussels, prawns and calamari.

items.name: The Countryside Orzo
items.story: Comfort from the hills, with a gentle heat.

items.name: Como Basilico
items.story: Basil and tomato, as Lake Como intended.
items.desc: Tomato and basil pasta with fresh parmesan.

items.name: Rome's Bolognese
items.story: Slow-cooked the Roman way — patience you can taste.
items.desc: Slow-cooked beef ragu tossed with pasta, rich tomato and parmesan.

items.name: Catch in Cape Town
items.story: Whatever the boats brought in, roasted with spice.
items.desc: Slightly spicy oven-roasted fish of the day on a bed of cherry tomatoes, olives and chorizo.

items.name: Oslo's Flame
items.story: Salmon, fire, and Nordic restraint.
items.desc: Grilled salmon with oven-roasted vegetables.

items.name: Johannesburg's Roast
items.story: The city's bird — lemon-herb or peri-peri.
items.desc: Roasted half or baby chicken, lemon and herb or peri-peri, served with its jus.

items.name: Texan Beef Burger
items.story: Big, unapologetic, and proud of it.
items.desc: Gourmet beef, fried egg, streaky bacon, roasted tomato and mayonnaise.

items.name: Texan Chicken Burger
items.story: Buttermilk-crisp with a smoky drawl.

items.name: Zoe's
